maidbuilder.configuration.title: Maid Builder Settings
maidbuilder.configuration.readonly.no_wo: Open a world to change its server settings.
maidbuilder.configuration.readonly.remot: Server settings can only be changed here in single player (edit serverconfig/maidbuilder-server.toml on the server).
maidbuilder.configuration.schematics.too: Limits for loading, uploading, pasting and capturing schematics.
maidbuilder.configuration.placeReach.too: How far (in blocks) a maid can place blocks from.
maidbuilder.configuration.placeFluids.to: Whether water/lava source blocks and waterlogged states from schematics are built. Territory templates always build theirs.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxAttempts.to: How many times a maid retries a block (unreachable / cannot survive) before leaving it to the player.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxScanPerSear: Maximum build steps inspected each time a maid looks for her next block. Higher finds buildable blocks more often but costs more.
maidbuilder.configuration.ownerRangeWith: When a builder maid is not in home mode, she only builds blocks this close to her owner.
maidbuilder.configuration.materialSource: How far a builder maid walks to a bound material container.
maidbuilder.configuration.workAreaMargin: When a block is out of reach, a maid looks for a way up only within this many blocks around the structure; beyond it she builds scaffolding.
maidbuilder.configuration.useScaffolding: Whether maids put up scaffolding (from their inventory or material containers) to reach high blocks, and take it down when done.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxScaffoldHei: Tallest scaffolding column a maid builds.
maidbuilder.configuration.clearMode.tool:
What builder maids break so the world matches the schematic (for jobs created afterwards; change a job with /maidbuilder job clearing).
OFF: nothing, wrong blocks are left for you.
REPLACE: a wrong block where the schematic has a block is broken and replaced.
ALL: also break blocks standing in the schematic's air near the building.
Containers, unbreakable blocks and the maidbuilder:never_break tag are never broken.
maidbuilder.configuration.clearRadius.to: With ALL, an air cell of the schematic is cleared only if a schematic block on the same layer is within this horizontal distance (a circle). A small building in a large schematic box does not clear the whole box; the ground below and the space above the roof stay as they are.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxBreakHardne: Hardest block a maid breaks (stone 1.5, iron block 5, obsidian 50); harder ones are left for you.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxSchematicVo: Largest schematic volume (x*y*z summed over regions) that will be loaded.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxUploadBytes: Largest schematic file (bytes) a client may upload to the server.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxPasteBlocks: Largest number of blocks /maidbuilder paste places in one go.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxCaptureVolu: Largest area the Blueprint Quill or /maidbuilder save may capture.
maidbuilder.configuration.showHud.toolti: Show placement, progress and missing materials in the top-left corner while holding a Blueprint Wand.
maidbuilder.configuration.ghostOpacity.t: Opacity of the ghost blocks of a placed schematic (1 = solid).
maidbuilder.configuration.previewRenderD: Parts of the preview farther away than this many blocks are not drawn.
maidbuilder.configuration.showWrongBlock: Outline blocks in red where the world has a different block than the schematic, and in orange the blocks the maids would clear from the schematic's air (when the server clears air).
maidbuilder.configuration.showBoundingBo: Draw a white box around the whole schematic.
With a shader pack (Oculus) active, draw the preview on top of the shaded image so the pack does not light the ghosts like real blocks. Turn off to let the pack shade the preview.

template.maidbuilder.warehouse.desc: A storehouse lined with 14 barrels. Maids working at buildings take their products here.
template.maidbuilder.sugar_cane_farm.des: Two water channels with 36 spots for sugar cane. A maid working here plants and harvests it (give her some cane).
template.maidbuilder.small_greenhouse.de: A 9x9 field watered from the middle, under a glass roof. Crops inside grow faster once the territory reaches the bonus level.
template.maidbuilder.lumberyard.desc: A fenced yard with four sapling spots and an open shed with a crafting table and a chest.
template.maidbuilder.ranch.desc: A fenced pen with a feeding shelter and hay. Animals inside breed again sooner at the bonus level.
template.maidbuilder.apiary.desc: Two beehives over campfires (the smoke keeps the bees calm) in a flower garden. Bring the bees yourself.
template.maidbuilder.dormitory.desc: A cottage with beds for four maids.
template.maidbuilder.large_greenhouse.de: Two 9x9 fields under one glass roof; counts as a greenhouse for upgrades.
template.maidbuilder.large_ranch.desc: Two connected pens; counts as a ranch for upgrades.
template.maidbuilder.fishing_dock.desc: A pier on log piles: put its lowest layer at the water surface. Maids fish sitting in a boat or on a cushion.
template.maidbuilder.pavilion.desc: An open pavilion with benches and a hanging lantern.

template.maidbuilder.canteen.desc: A dining house with tables and stoves. While it stands, the owner's maids in the territory heal (twice as fast with the maid healing bonus).
template.maidbuilder.village_hall.desc: A hall with three beds and job site blocks. Every 20 minutes a villager moves in, until three live around it.
template.maidbuilder.trading_post.desc: A fenced yard with a counter. Every 30 minutes a wandering trader comes and stays for a while. Use its cartography table to travel to your other trading posts (sneak to use the table as usual).
template.maidbuilder.watchtower.desc: A tall lookout. Hostile mobs within 48 blocks glow, and you are told when a raid starts nearby.
template.maidbuilder.shrine.desc: A torii, a stone path with lanterns and a small hall. While it stands, the owner's maids in the territory gain favorability once a day.
